title: Ai assisted and partly generated. What do yo think could be improved (WIP video looking for feedback)?
author: No-Fix-63
selftext:
I added sneak peak to new footage.   
  
So the clip is pretty raw work in progress. However you can see the improved base building mechanics. There are some stuff that is missing from it so I will most likely recreate the clip, however I promised some footage for today so this will have to for now.   
  
Questions:   
What do you think of the idea?   
What would you like to see more being developed?   
Would this work as a partial trailer and how would you improve it?   
  
Things half way through and not included in video: -Boss fights -Advanced/improved Energy grid visualization   
\-We will improve the drone cable mechanics. They need some polishing + more different kind of drones and containers etc.   
\-Combat video later. This is a teaser.   
\-I will build new better designed base for the final.
